trust_decision.summary: The Referer header from any anonymous visitor is stored after only URL-character sanitising (no quote/paren stripping, no host validation). On the stats page its derived 'domain' is trusted as safe to splice into an inline JS data table and a single-quoted img src attribute. Deciding what may reach those sinks is split between yourls_get_domain (producer) and the two output builders.

landing_point.why: The summary says 'referrer statistics chart'. The chart is built by yourls_google_array_to_data_table, which interpolates labels raw into a JS string literal.

fix_sites.entry_point: GET /<keyword>+ stats page (yourls-loader.php:56-59 -> yourls-infos.php:72), data stored via short-URL redirect yourls-go.php -> yourls_log_redirect (includes/functions.php:532)
fix_sites.module_kind: producer/helper: URL->domain mapper that feeds both chart and favicon sinks

fix_sites.entry_point: GET /<keyword>+ stats page: referrer list favicon (yourls-infos.php:506-507) and long-URL favicon (yourls-infos.php:241)
fix_sites.module_kind: wrapper: builds a URL echoed into an HTML attribute

fix_sites.entry_point: GET /<keyword>+ stats page: referrer pie (yourls-infos.php:497) via yourls_stats_pie (includes/functions-infos.php:84-85); also reached by countries map/pie and line charts

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: includes/functions-infos.php:279-281 consumed at yourls-infos.php:507 (img src='$favicon' single-quoted attribute, far from the chart code)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The report is about the chart (JS), and the favicon is a URL pointing at Google's favicon service rendered as an . A solver can argue that sanitize_url_safe already strips < > " and spaces, so the HTML list 'can't' be injected.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Must keep working: IDN, IPv4/IPv6 and port-bearing referrers still group by host; scheme-less referrers fall back to the path as host; data-table values that are numeric or start with '[' / '{' stay as raw JS literals (used by the options and colour arrays); translated labels like 'Others'/'Direct' with apostrophes still render. An over-broad fix (drop every non-ASCII host, or quote every value) breaks grouping or the charts.

O6_input_shapes: referrer with scheme://host where host carries quote/paren chars
scheme-less referrer where parse_url host is empty and path becomes host (includes/functions-infos.php:263-264)
seriously malformed URL where parse_url returns false

O7_producer.where: includes/functions-infos.php:256-270 (yourls_get_domain, called at yourls-infos.php:72 when building $referrers keys)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: $site echoed raw into the HTML text of the referrer list (only safe because the producer now validates the host)
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: It already exists unescaped. In our copy a sibling that echoes the full referrer URL key (not the host) raw beside it would be a plausible maintainer shortcut instead of yourls_html_link.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: yourls_google_viz_code interpolates option values and $id into JS without escaping; a stats option derived from referrer/UA data (e.g. a chart title) would be a realistic second JS serializer at distance
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: It is the same hand-rolled JS-literal pattern as the fixed data-table builder, in the same file, and plugins already feed options through the stats_pie_options filter (includes/functions-infos.php:82).

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A 'top user agents' pie built from the stored user_agent column (sanitized to allow ' ( ) ; ) through yourls_stats_pie
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The UA is already logged (includes/functions.php:533) but never displayed. A UA chart is a natural feature addition, and its filter keeps the single quotes that break the JS literal.

O9_family: CWE-79 stored XSS (output-context escaping in inline JS and HTML attribute)

O10_build.toolchain: PHP 8.x + composer deps vendored in includes/vendor; PHPUnit
O10_build.project_tests: tests/tests/format/URLTest.php (URL sanitising; no get_domain/data_table tests at pinned commit); tests/tests/stats/StatsTest.php

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Wrap $label with yourls_esc_js in yourls_google_array_to_data_table only, leaving the favicon img src='...' attribute at yourls-infos.php:507 fed by an unvalidated yourls_get_domain (path-as-host fallback).

out_of_scope_notes: yourls-infos.php:462 echoes country $code raw; the value comes from the GeoIP DB, so it is not under the referrer's control.
The get_referrer filter (includes/functions.php:243) lets plugins return arbitrary values; that is plugin trust, outside this advisory.
